what_this_is: One entry per Zenodo deposit this repository cites. It exists because the deposits live outside the release path: nothing in this repo fails when a deposited file is later edited here, so the repo and the permanent record drift apart silently. tests/test_zenodo_manifest.py is the mechanism that was missing.
what_this_is_not: This manifest was built entirely from inside the repository. No Zenodo API call was made and no deposit page was fetched. Every statement about what a remote record CONTAINS is either (a) quoted from a deposit receipt this repo committed at deposit time, or (b) marked UNCHECKABLE. Where a receipt exists it is named in `evidence`. Absence of a receipt is not evidence that a deposit is wrong; it means we cannot check it from here.
hashing_note: Two hashes are recorded per text file. `sha256_local_bytes` is the sha256 of the bytes in THIS checkout; on Windows with core.autocrlf=true those bytes are CRLF, and the same file checked out on Linux CI is LF, so that hash is NOT portable. `sha256_lf_normalized` (CRLF collapsed to LF before hashing) is the portable content identity and is what the drift test asserts on. This is the same failure the repo's own .gitattributes records for styxx/centroids/*.json, where a CRLF-rendered pin broke an LF CI checkout. For binary files (pdf, png, zip) normalization is meaningless and would corrupt the file, so only `sha256_local_bytes` is recorded and asserted.

status_vocabulary.TRACKED: A local counterpart exists, is hashed here, and we have no evidence it diverges from the deposited copy.
status_vocabulary.DIVERGED: The deposited copy is known to differ from the repo copy. The evidence is stated in the entry.
status_vocabulary.NO_LOCAL_COUNTERPART: Nothing in this repo corresponds to the deposited content, so there is nothing to hash.
status_vocabulary.UNCHECKABLE: The repo does not record what this deposit contains. We do not guess.
status_vocabulary.DRAFT_OR_RESERVED: The repo records a reserved DOI or a draft deposition id, not a confirmed published record.
status_vocabulary.THIRD_PARTY: Not a Fathom deposit. Cited as a source. Never our drift to fix.

kind_vocabulary.CONCEPT: A Zenodo concept DOI: resolves to the latest version in its chain.
kind_vocabulary.VERSION: A Zenodo version DOI: resolves to one frozen record.
kind_vocabulary.UNCHECKABLE: The repo does not say which, and we will not infer it from the number.

open_questions: papers/cognometry-manifesto.md carries a 2026-06-21 erratum and is referred to in prose as 'the Cognometry Manifesto (10.5281/zenodo.19703527)'. The committed receipt for 19703527 lists cognometry-v0.pdf / cognometry-v0.md / cognometry-research-agenda-2026.md and does NOT list cognometry-manifesto.md. Whether the manifesto text is in that deposit under a different filename is UNCHECKABLE from inside the repo. If it is, 19703527 is a third diverged deposit and not merely two.

10.5281/zenodo.19502716 is attached as a related identifier for 'Fathom Cognitive Atlas v0.3' while 10.5281/zenodo.19502715 is labelled its concept DOI in-repo. The adjacent-id pattern (concept=n, first version=n+1) matches the one confirmed pair 19758618/19758619, but that is inference from a number, not a verified fact, so 19502716's kind is left UNCHECKABLE.
